import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}collection-fee-setups`;// Get Data
const getCollectionFees=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Create 
const createCollectionFees=async(approvalWorkflowData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,approvalWorkflowData,config);return response.data;};// update
const updateCollectionFees=async(id,newData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+id,newData,config);return response.data;};// Delete
